summary: Tsutomu Hatai (1923–2018) worked in Indology and served as president of the Ayurveda Research Society, where he succeeded Hiroshi Maruyama, as attested in 1987.
Tsutomu Horio (born 1949) is a scholar of philosophy and Buddhist studies. He studied under Keiji Nishitani and was a professor at Otani University, attested in 1990.

Tsutomu Kubo (1883–1972) was a philosopher who studied under Raphael von Koeber at the University of Tokyo (~1907–1912) and earned a doctorate from Tohoku University. He taught at Tohoku University (1929; 1940–1946) and Toyo University (~1949–1954).

Tsutomu Yamaguchi (born 1953) works in philosophy, religious studies, and Buddhist studies. He studied at Hokkaido University and has served as a collaborative researcher at the Nakamura Hajime Eastern Institute, attested in 2015 and 2026.

Tsuyoshi Yokoyama works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He pursued doctoral studies at Kyoto University (attested 2015–2017) and served as a special appointment researcher at the International College for Postgraduate Buddhist Studies, attested in 2017.

Tsyben Zhamtsarano (1880–1942) was a scholar of linguistics and Iranian and Central Asian studies. He studied at Saint Petersburg State University in 1902 and headed the Mongolian Academy of Sciences.

Tu Weiming (born 1940) studied at Tunghai, Tokai, and Harvard universities under Zongsan Mou, Chun-i Tang, and Fuguan Xu. A scholar of philosophy, Sinology, and religion, he held professorships at UC Berkeley, Harvard (1981–2010), and Peking University (~2010).

Tubten Chokyi Dorje studied under Patrul Rinpoche, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye, and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso. He taught Shenphen Nangwa, Khenpo Ngawang Pelzang, Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Dodrupchen Rinpoche, and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje.
Tubten Gyeltsen Ozer was a scholar who studied under Patrul Rinpoche, Jamyang Khyentse Wangpo, and Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye.

Tubten Nyendrak (1883–1959) was a scholar of Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied under Shenphen Nangwa, Jamgön Kongtrül Lodrö Thaye, and Jamgon Ju Mipham Gyatso, and taught Botrul Dongak Tenpai Nyima and Dodrupchen Rinpoche.
Tubten Nyima was a scholar who studied under Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö and Dodrupchen Rinpoche.
Tubten Tsondru studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Dodrupchen Rinpoche, Khunu Lama Tenzin Gyaltsen, and Khenpo Gangshar. He taught Khenchen Palden Sherab Rinpoche and Ringu Tulku.

Tukaram Ramchandra Laddu was a scholar of Indology and linguistics. He studied at the Martin Luther University of Halle-Wittenberg until 1912 and held a post at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University, attested in 1920.
Tulku Hungkar Dorje studied under Penor Rinpoche and Dodrupchen Rinpoche.

Tulku Sherdor (born 1961) is a scholar of Buddhist studies and Tibetology. He studied at Vassar College, Naropa University, and the University of Virginia, learning under Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, Ted Norton, and Jeffrey Hopkins.

Tulku Thondup (1939–2023) was a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Dodrupchen Monastery under Kyala Khenpo, Khenpo Chemchok, and Dodrupchen Rinpoche. He later served as a visiting scholar at Harvard University.

Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche (1920–1996) was a Buddhist studies and Tibetology master who founded Tergar Osel Ling Monastery. He studied under Samten Gyatso, Jamyang Khyentse Chökyi Lodrö, Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Karsé Kongtrul, and Rangjung Rigpe Dorje.

Turrell V. Wylie (1927–1984) was a Tibetologist, linguist, and Sinologist who studied at the University of Washington and under Giuseppe Tucci and Dezhung Rinpoche. He was an associate professor (1959) and professor (1970) at the University of Washington.
Tutob Chökyi Wangchuk was a scholar who studied under Dilgo Khyentse Rinpoche, Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, Rangjung Rigpe Dorje, and Trulshik Rinpoche.

Tyler Dewar works in Tibetology and Buddhist studies. He studied at the Nitartha Institute and under traditional teachers Tashi Wangchuk (2003–2004), Lama Tenpa Gyaltsen (2005), and Dzogchen Ponlop Rinpoche (attested 2019).
